subject: [PATCH v8 13/30] mm: handle PMD swap entries in fork path

2026-10-02.patch_summary: This patch addresses an issue where PMD swap entries are not handled correctly in the fork path, leading to duplicated and unreferenced page table slots. The patch introduces a new function `copy_huge_non_present_pmd` that duplicates PMD swap entries by creating new references to the underlying pages and updating the mm counter accordingly. It also updates the `copy_huge_pmd` function to handle GFP_ATOMIC allocation failures for extend-tables, allowing the fork process to retry with GFP_KERNEL. The patch further refactors the code to move the mm counter update into each entry-type arm, improving consistency and accuracy in page table management.
